body:
🤖 Non-blocking cleanup suggestions for da9fa9c:

1. Remove the support wrapper in [_fa4_cute_kernels.py:1272](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/blob/da9fa9c23ba81c11a36280170e323a48cd8ac24e/lib/levanter/src/levanter/grug/attention/_fa4_cute_kernels.py#L1272). `_NativeSegmentedBackwardSupport` only groups three helpers. Give zero-fill its own factory and call the existing mask/view factories directly. `segmented_flash_attention_backward_launcher` does not use the bundled mask.
2. Rename the shared SM90 helpers in [_fa4_cute_backend.py:503](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/blob/da9fa9c23ba81c11a36280170e323a48cd8ac24e/lib/levanter/src/levanter/grug/attention/_fa4_cute_backend.py#L503). Names such as `_cutlass_attention_backward_sm90_preprocess_specs` also serve SM100. Use `native` for these shared helpers so their names describe their scope.
3. Remove impossible test combinations in [test_fa4_cute_attention.py:463](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/blob/da9fa9c23ba81c11a36280170e323a48cd8ac24e/lib/levanter/tests/grug/test_fa4_cute_attention.py#L463). The parameter product creates 36 permanently skipped cases for unsupported SM100 layouts. Parameterize supported backend/layout pairs directly.
4. Delete stale output instructions in [tile_sweep.py:24](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/blob/da9fa9c23ba81c11a36280170e323a48cd8ac24e/experiments/benchmarks/fa4/tile_sweep.py#L24). “Read the correctness column before any timing column” refers to the previous table output. The script emits JSONL records.

The first item gives the clearest code reduction. Keep the dense-reference and gradient tests.

🤖 Applied all four suggestions as separate commits on top of the reviewed head `da9fa9c`, with no force-push:

1. `397394b` removes `_NativeSegmentedBackwardSupport`; zero-fill has its own factory and callers use the mask and view factories directly.
2. `3149f9b` renames the arch-neutral backward helpers from `_cutlass_attention_backward_sm90_*` to `_native_backward_*`, and the preprocess launcher to `native_flash_attention_backward_preprocess_launcher`. Helpers that only serve SM90 keep their names.
3. `15ca3c3` parametrizes the sequence-sharded test over supported backend/layout pairs, removing the 36 always-skipped cases.
4. `b8c8c3b` drops the stale correctness-column note from the tile sweep docstring.

Compare since your review: https://github.com/marin-community/marin/compare/da9fa9c23b..b8c8c3b089
